QuestInfo.name: Dial H For Hero 1
QuestInfo.1:
Three Moon and Nero want you to rescue the
#bmissing people#k and resolve the issue in
Ellinel. Should be two birds with one stone.
QuestInfo.2: You've rescued everyone who ended up in Ellinel. That means everyone else might be somewhere in Maple World, too! Go ask Three Moon if there have been any other disturbances like the one in Ellinel. \r\n
QuestInfo.0: Three Moon has had plenty of time to compare reports on missing people. Go talk to him.
